compiled_state.description:
## Context (discovered while fixing bug 3fa7-94ba-42aa-4623)

The Gerrit Verified gate executes workflow files from TRUSTED MAIN, not the patchset (proven on change 2115 PS1: its own run 32587991195 still executed main's stale `--timeout=20`, headSha 6a5c88027c5). pytest-timeout precedence is MARKER > CLI > env > INI (`_get_item_settings`, pytest_timeout.py:388; verified empirically incl. marker-applied-at-collection under `-n 2 --dist worksteal`). Consequence: ANY future per-test-budget change carried in `pyproject.toml` is overridden on its own gate run by the previous `--timeout=<old>` CLI flag in `_build-and-test.yml`, so a budget fix can never be exercised by its own Verified run — the class of failure that made 2115 PS1 fail its own gate. Bug 3fa7 was ultimately landed by an operator-cast Verified+1, which is not a repeatable path.

## Proposed mechanism (implemented + validated, preserved on branch `preserve/timeout-floor-hardening` based on a42a9d8d494 — REBASE over 53eaea07aa2 before use)

A conftest FLOOR, not a blanket: `tests/_timeout_floor.py`, called from `tests/conftest.py`'s `pytest_collection_modifyitems` — when the effective non-marker budget (CLI > PYTEST_TIMEOUT env > ini) is positive and BELOW the ini budget, apply the ini budget as `pytest.mark.timeout(budget, method=<ini>, func_only=<ini>)` to every item without an explicit timeout marker. Floor semantics keep the live lanes' deliberately larger CLI budgets (900/600/1800/3600 s) intact (marker > CLI would silently lower them under a blanket), and `--timeout=0` (explicit disable) stays respected. The preserved branch also removes the now-redundant lane flags and rewrites the two parity contracts in tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py accordingly (NOTE: conflicts with 53eaea07aa2's --max-worker-restart=0 lane edit + its parity test; reconcile on rebase).

Validated locally on the preserved branch: a 25 s two-test probe under `-n 2 --dist worksteal --timeout=20 --timeout-method=thread` against the repo config passed with zero node-downs (pre-floor this crashed the workers); a looser CLI budget still wins (floor is not a ceiling); an unmarked over-budget test with no CLI flag is still killed by the ini alone; make lint / typecheck / complexity ratchet green.

## Open design question

Floor semantics neutralize deliberately TIGHTER ad-hoc CLI runs inside tests/ (e.g. crash-amplifier debugging with --timeout=5); such experiments must use a scratch project outside tests/. Decide whether that trade is acceptable, or gate the floor on an env var (e.g. skip when REBAR_TIMEOUT_FLOOR=0).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] An unmarked test whose body fits the ini budget survives a tighter `--timeout` CLI flag; verified by an in-repo contract test with a no-hook negative control.
- [ ] A larger CLI budget is not lowered by the floor; verified by a contract test.
- [ ] `--timeout=0` still disables timeouts entirely; verified by a contract test.
- [ ] Shared-tier lanes' redundant `--timeout`/`--timeout-method` flags removed; parity contracts in test_ci_workflow_parity.py updated without weakening the hang guard (an unmarked hung test is still bounded — negative arm).
- [ ] docs/local-dev-env.md documents the floor.
compiled_state.title: Make the ini hang budget authoritative over stale trusted-main CLI --timeout flags (conftest marker floor)
